adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts), the code does `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` and then conditionally `credential.update` or `credential.create`. This is a non-atomic check-then-insert pattern, so concurrent webhook calls for the same (userId, appSlug/appId) can race: both can see no existing credential and attempt to create. The diff does not show any transaction/upsert/locking to prevent this, so it can result in duplicates if there is no DB uniqueness constraint, or a failing create if a uniqueness constraint exists (still broken behavior under concurrency).
